observations: A white truck-mounted borehole drilling rig with an orange mast and assembly.
The truck grille features a circular 'UD' logo and 'NISSAN DIESEL' text in photos 0, 1, and 2.
Multiple drill pipes are stored in a rack on the side of the vehicle.
The equipment is parked on a red dirt/construction site.
A red cement mixer and a white van are visible in the background.
The truck has a Nigerian license plate, though the characters are not clearly legible.
The drilling mast is in a lowered, transport position.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the truck-mounted drilling mast and pipes.
The photos are static and do not show the engine running or the rig in operation.

risks.risk: Hydraulic system failure or leaks in the mast lifting cylinders.
risks.proof: A video showing the mast being fully raised and lowered without hesitation or visible leaks.

risks.risk: Truck or rig engine mechanical issues.
risks.proof: A video of both the truck engine and the rig's power take-off (PTO) or auxiliary engine starting and running.

risks.risk: Seized or damaged rotary head/drilling mechanism.
risks.proof: A video showing the rotary head spinning and moving along the mast.

proof_requests: Video of the drilling rig in full operation, including raising the mast and rotating the head.
Video of the truck engine starting from cold and idling.
Close-up photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the drilling rig unit.
Clear photos of the truck's dashboard and hour meter for the rig.
response.reason: The provided comparables consist of a tipper truck and a Toyota Tacoma pickup, neither of which are borehole drilling machines. There is no relevant price data to value this specialized equipment.
